project.name: Wispr Flow Killer
project.description: A superior, privacy-focused, and smarter alternative to Wispr Flow. Instant startup, invisible UI, context-aware voice dictation with hybrid architecture.

user_stories.title: Implement Audio Hardware Management
user_stories.description: Ensure the app can manage audio hardware like a native macOS app.
acceptance_criteria: Microphone Selector: Dropdown in settings to choose input device
Hot-plugging: Auto-detect when devices are added/removed (e.g., AirPods connected)
Visual Feedback: Small level meter in settings to test the mic

user_stories.title: Implement System Tray (Menu Bar)
user_stories.description: Add macOS menu bar integration for quick access.
acceptance_criteria: Icon in the macOS top bar
Menu items: "Settings", "Check for Updates", "Quit"
Ability to open Settings even if the main widget is hidden

user_stories.title: Implement Launch at Login
user_stories.description: Allow the app to start automatically when user logs in.
acceptance_criteria: Integrate tauri-plugin-autostart
Add toggle in Settings: "Start at login"

user_stories.title: Fix Global Hotkey Registration
user_stories.description: Ensure global hotkeys work reliably across the app.
acceptance_criteria: App.tsx: Implement useEffect to call registerHotkey on mount
Add conflict detection: If the hotkey is taken, warn the user

user_stories.title: Implement Permission Guard System
user_stories.description: Handle macOS permissions gracefully to prevent app failure.
acceptance_criteria: Startup Check: On launch, verify Accessibility and Microphone permissions
Blocker UI: If permissions missing, show a friendly setup screen
Deep Links: Add buttons to open macOS System Settings directly
Polling: Auto-detect when permission is granted

user_stories.title: Restore & Connect VoiceRecorder
user_stories.description: Reconnect the voice recording functionality to the UI.
acceptance_criteria: Re-create VoiceRecorder.tsx
Connect src/lib/audio/recorder.ts to global hotkey events
Verify pipeline: Stop Rec -> Get Audio -> API Call -> Text Injection

user_stories.title: Implement Compact Floating Capsule
user_stories.description: Transform the app from a window to an intelligent floating widget.
acceptance_criteria: Config: width: ~400px, height: ~60px, transparent, alwaysOnTop, no-decorations
Position: Bottom-center (floating above the dock)
Behavior: Auto-hide when idle, Instant fade-in on hotkey press, "Shake" animation on error

user_stories.title: Implement Design System: Glass & Motion
user_stories.description: Create a beautiful, adaptive visual design with animations.
acceptance_criteria: Visualizer Bar: Realtime audio waveform using Canvas or CSS bars
States & Transitions: Listening (Red/Warm pulse), Thinking (Blue/Cool shimmer), Success (Green flash/Checkmark -> Fade out)
Theme: Adaptive (System Dark/Light), utilizing backdrop-blur-xl

user_stories.title: Implement The Smart Hotkey
user_stories.description: Create perfect Hold vs Toggle interaction experience.
acceptance_criteria: Interaction State Machine: Hold Mode, Toggle Mode, Cancel
Custom Hotkey Manager: Support single keys, allow remapping Record/Commit/Cancel

user_stories.title: Implement Audio Feedback (Sound UX)
user_stories.description: Add sound cues for non-visual feedback.
acceptance_criteria: Sound Cues: Add start.mp3, stop.mp3, success.mp3, error.mp3
Add "Mute Sounds" toggle

user_stories.title: Implement Context Awareness
user_stories.description: Make the app adapt to where the user is typing.
acceptance_criteria: Active App Detection: Detect focused app bundle ID
Dynamic System Prompt: Dev Mode, Chat Mode, Pro Mode

user_stories.title: Implement Post-Processing Voice Commands
user_stories.description: Add intelligence to voice commands for editing.
acceptance_criteria: "Magic Edit": Detect commands at the end of recording (e.g., "Make it shorter")

user_stories.title: Implement Multi-Engine Support
user_stories.description: Provide options for different AI providers for every user type.
acceptance_criteria: OpenRouter (Default): Best balance
Custom OpenAI-Compatible API: Any provider
Groq Integration: Extreme speed
Local LLM (Ollama): Privacy/Offline

user_stories.title: Implement Smart Injection & Undo Safety
user_stories.description: Make text injection flexible and safe.
acceptance_criteria: Injection Method Selector: Simulation (Cmd+V) or Accessibility API
Smart Spacing: Auto-insert space before text
Paste Queue: Handle rapid-fire dictations

user_stories.title: Implement Distribution & Updates
user_stories.description: Make the app distributable and updatable.
acceptance_criteria: GitHub Actions: Automate builds
Notarization: Sign app with Apple Developer ID
Auto-Updater: Configure Tauri updater

user_stories.title: Implement Localization (i18n)
user_stories.description: Support multiple languages in the UI.
acceptance_criteria: UI Translation: English / Russian

user_stories.title: Implement Resilience
user_stories.description: Make the app robust against network and other issues.
acceptance_criteria: Network Handling: Graceful timeouts
Error Reporting: Local log collection

user_stories.title: Configure Floating Window Properties
user_stories.description: Set up the basic properties for the compact floating capsule window.
acceptance_criteria: Configure window width to ~400px, height to ~60px
Set window to transparent, always on top, no decorations

user_stories.title: Implement Bottom-Center Positioning
user_stories.description: Position the floating capsule at the bottom-center of the screen.
acceptance_criteria: Position window floating above the dock in bottom-center

user_stories.title: Add Auto-Hide and Animation Behaviors
user_stories.description: Implement auto-hide when idle, instant fade-in, and shake animation on error.
acceptance_criteria: Auto-hide after 5 seconds of inactivity
Fade-in within 200ms on hotkey press
Shake animation on error

user_stories.title: Create Audio Waveform Visualizer
user_stories.description: Implement the realtime audio waveform visualizer.
acceptance_criteria: Use Canvas or CSS bars for waveform display
Waveform updates at 60fps

user_stories.title: Implement State Transition Animations
user_stories.description: Add animations for listening, thinking, and success states.
acceptance_criteria: Listening: Red/Warm pulse
Thinking: Blue/Cool shimmer
Success: Green flash/Checkmark -> Fade out within 300ms

user_stories.title: Add Adaptive Theme Support
user_stories.description: Implement system dark/light theme adaptation with backdrop blur.
acceptance_criteria: Adaptive theme based on system settings
Utilize backdrop-blur-xl

user_stories.title: Build Hotkey Interaction State Machine
user_stories.description: Implement the state machine for hold vs toggle hotkey interactions.
acceptance_criteria: Support Hold Mode, Toggle Mode, Cancel states

user_stories.title: Add Custom Hotkey Remapping Interface
user_stories.description: Create interface to remap record, commit, and cancel hotkeys.
acceptance_criteria: Support single keys
Allow remapping Record/Commit/Cancel

user_stories.title: Detect Active Application Bundle ID
user_stories.description: Implement detection of the focused application's bundle ID.
acceptance_criteria: Detect bundle ID of active app

user_stories.title: Implement Dynamic System Prompts
user_stories.description: Add dynamic prompts based on application context.
acceptance_criteria: Dev Mode for code editors (e.g., VS Code)
Chat Mode for messaging apps
Pro Mode for professional writing

user_stories.title: Add OpenRouter Integration
user_stories.description: Integrate OpenRouter as the default AI provider.
acceptance_criteria: Best balance of quality and speed

user_stories.title: Add Custom OpenAI-Compatible API
user_stories.description: Support any OpenAI-compatible API provider.
acceptance_criteria: Flexible API endpoint configuration

user_stories.title: Integrate Groq
user_stories.description: Add Groq integration for extreme speed.
acceptance_criteria: Low-latency processing

user_stories.title: Add Local LLM Support
user_stories.description: Integrate Ollama for local LLM processing.
acceptance_criteria: Privacy-focused offline processing

user_stories.title: Add Injection Method Selector
user_stories.description: Implement selector for simulation or accessibility API injection.
acceptance_criteria: Choose between Cmd+V simulation or Accessibility API

user_stories.title: Implement Smart Spacing Logic
user_stories.description: Auto-insert space before injected text.
acceptance_criteria: Detect and insert space when needed

user_stories.title: Create Paste Queue System
user_stories.description: Handle rapid-fire dictations with a queue.
acceptance_criteria: Queue multiple injections and process sequentially

user_stories.title: Design and Implement Hybrid Local/Cloud Architecture
user_stories.description: Combine local and cloud processing for optimal performance.
acceptance_criteria: Local processing for basic tasks
Cloud fallback for complex operations

user_stories.title: Implement Privacy Features
user_stories.description: Add data privacy and security measures.
acceptance_criteria: Local data handling
Encryption for sensitive data

user_stories.title: Add User Onboarding and Tutorials
user_stories.description: Create onboarding flow for permissions and features.
acceptance_criteria: Guide users through permission setup
Tutorial for key features

user_stories.title: Optimize App Performance and Startup Time
user_stories.description: Improve performance for instant startup.
acceptance_criteria: Startup time under 2 seconds
Optimize resource usage

user_stories.title: Implement Accessibility Features
user_stories.description: Add screen reader support and keyboard navigation.
acceptance_criteria: Screen reader compatibility
Full keyboard navigation

user_stories.title: Refine Audio Hardware Management Testability
user_stories.description: Make visual feedback measurable.
acceptance_criteria: Level meter shows dB levels within 1dB accuracy

user_stories.title: Add Sound Playback Verification
user_stories.description: Verify sound cues play at correct volumes and timings.
acceptance_criteria: Sounds play at specified volumes and timings

user_stories.title: Specify Magic Edit Detection Criteria
user_stories.description: Define detection accuracy for voice commands.
acceptance_criteria: Detects at least 80% of common commands like 'make it shorter'

user_stories.title: Specify Network Timeout Durations
user_stories.description: Add specific timeout and retry logic.
acceptance_criteria: Timeouts after 30 seconds with retry logic

user_stories.title: Implement Core Dictation Pipeline
user_stories.description: Connect the complete dictation workflow from recording to text injection.
acceptance_criteria: Connect recording → transcription → editing → injection in sequence

user_stories.title: Add End-to-End Integration Testing
user_stories.description: Add tests to verify the complete user flow.
acceptance_criteria: Verify the complete user flow from hotkey press to text injection
